column3: Assistance to and Protection of Victims
4. A victim of crime shall have the right, upon a request
made by such victim of crime, to be informed-

(a)
by the Authority or the Protection Division or any

(i)
of  the  measures  of  protection  available  to
such victim of crime under this Act;

(ii)
of  the  legal  remedies  including  delictual
remedies available for the redress of any injury
which such victim of crime has suffered; and

(iii)
of the time periods within which legal action
shall  be  instituted  to  obtain  legal  remedies;
